title: mpmath far anchors corrected: the dps-20/30/40 logzeta channels at 1e8G/3e8G/5e8G were corrupted by a broken ADR rssum correction (rssumS3 = 13.86 magnitude at dps-40 vs 1.18e-5 true, S1 exact at every precision; mpmath dps-15 agrees with the C channel to 1e-12) - the C/quad channel is the zeta channel of record past the wall (5e8G logzeta 2.9370199551, NOT 1.7289704098; the old 'dps-15 outlier' verdict flips), the M values of the three far rows are UNCHANGED (f64 association is lz-insensitive at the 1e18-1e19 scale: M_old == M_new bit-exact, integer quantization resid exactly 0.0), the far-drift shape stands, and three new past-the-wall logzeta datums land from the C channel (1e9G -1.211098446310, 1e10G 0.455887846369, 3e10G 2.012486593295)
body: DATA MILESTONE + TOOLING MILESTONE (no RH claim).  CONTEXT: the s34 C/quad Riemann-Siegel channel (scripts/rh/zetac: QD hi/lo __float128 arithmetic, hand-declared quadmath prototypes linked against the runtime libquadmath.so.0 - no dev headers, no sudo; tables emitted as exact integer triples) was built to break the mpmath RS memory wall [9e18, 3e19).  VALIDATION: the C formula matches fresh-process mpmath dps-40 to ~1e-12 at t = 1e17, 3e17, 7e17, 1.5e18 (t/G = 3.3, 23, 53, 1000); an INDEPENDENT bare-cosine assembly (2*sum cos(theta - t ln n)/sqrt(n), no F/c/rssum tables; shares only the QD math + constants) agrees with the full C form to 1.3e-5..2.9e-5 at 1e8G/3e8G/5e8G/1e9G (the rssum*S3 + O(t^-1/4) scale) - both C assemblies are in agreement at every height, full-form and bare, to the expected cross-assembly tolerance.  THE FINDING: the mpmath dps-20/30/40 logzeta values of the three extreme far rows are CORRUPTED by mpmath's own ADR rssum correction (the Arias-de-Reyna F/coefficient machinery), not by S1.  The 5e8G decomposition (instrumented mpmath, fresh process, S1 + rz = S1 + rssum*S3 captured at dps-15 and dps-40, same exact t):  (i) S1 at dps-40 = (-2.3278963398604178, -9.2544934238805307) matches the C S1 (-2.3278963398604309, -9.254493423880497) to ~2e-14 - S1 is exact at both precisions;  (ii) rssumS3 at dps-40 = (-5.6333608928981085, -12.641483393444577), magnitude 13.86 - GARBAGE (true scale 1.18e-5);  (iii) the dps-15 run: S1 to 2e-14 of C, rssumS3 = (9.145e-06, 7.462e-06) magnitude 1.18e-5 (clean), and |zeta| = 18.859560149492072 = the C value 18.859560149492065 to 1e-14 - mpmath dps-15 is EXACT at 5e8G.  Corollary: the 'dps-15 is a precision outlier' verdict (discovery 0096) FLIPS: dps-15 was the truthful run; dps-20/30/40 are the corrupted ones (they agree with each other to 10 digits because they share the same coarse rssum garbage - the error dwarfs the precision difference).  MECHANISM NOTE (recorded, not fully adjudicated): mpmath computes S1 at wpsum = 4 + mag(N*ln N/eps) + 10 (accurate at all run precisions - confirmed by a zetasum_sieved working-width sweep on a 1e7-term subrange: exact at wp >= 100, the S1 path is exonerated at every relevant width); the corruption is in the rssum F/coefficient chain at the high working-width chains (J >= ~33 / L = 4 / M = 9-12; dps-15's smaller chain J ~ 28 is clean).  The rssum garbage magnitude (13.86 at 5e8G) is height-dependent through the chain and the S3 = a^(-1/2) scale; the S1-exact + rssum-garbage pattern means mpmath's dps-20+ zeta at far heights is off by 2*Re(e^itheta * rssum_garbage * S3) = the observed 1.2..4.9 in log|zeta|.  CORRECTED FAR CHANNELS (provenance C/quad, cross-checked):  1e8G  logzeta = 1.455437142349  (was 4.4929618099354; d = -3.037525)  3e8G  logzeta = 3.284789950625  (was -1.5728021802385705; d = +4.857592)  5e8G  logzeta = 2.9370199551  (was 1.7289704098; d = +1.208050; C + mpmath dps-15 agree to 1e-12).  M-VALUES UNCHANGED: recomputing the canonical f64 identity M = eps + lz - lm - la - re - I_far (left-to-right float64, the census association of record) with the corrected lz gives M_old == M_new BIT-EXACT at all three rows (-648727552, -1458497536, -3035441152) with the integer-quantization residual exactly 0.0 - the f64 association at the 1e18-1e19 scale absorbs lz shifts below ~O(512) in its 1e18-scale intermediate roundings, so the lz corrections do not move the locked M values; the far-drift shape is therefore UNCHANGED (|M|(x) quadratic, x = (t/G)/1e8 = 1,3,5: a2 = +9.58967040e+07, a1 = +2.12981760e+07, a0 = +5.31532672e+08, residuals <= 8.3e-7 f64 rounding; |I_far|/t = 7.85398..7.85399e-01 constant to 6 digits; local exponents 0.7374 (1->3) and 1.4348 (3->5)).  The s33 re-deconvolution (g-side window [1e10G, 1e12G], degeneracy ~2 decades) is FITTED ON THE M VALUES, so it is UNAFFECTED by this correction - it stands.  NEW PAST-THE-WALL DATUMS (C channel, no mpmath exists there - that is why the channel was built):  1e9G  t = 3.00010459999819776e+19:  logzeta = -1.211098446310  (bare-cos cross |Z| 0.297861107854 vs full 0.2978699056, d = 8.8e-06)  1e10G t = 3.00010459999819727e+20:  logzeta = 0.455887846369  3e10G t = 9.00031379999459246e+20:  logzeta = 2.012486593295  (bare-cos cross queued: s34b chain 5)  The M values of these three rows require the stream channels (s34f 1e9G queued behind the memory release; s34j does 1e10G + 3e10G) - queued, not yet locked.  SUBWALL RE-VERIFICATION (corrected, post-lock): the last sub-wall census row is 5e7G (a = 4.886e8, t = G*5e7 = 1.50005e18), which is the SAME height class as the verified-clean point t = 1.5e18 (a = 4.886e8, fresh-process C == mpmath dps-40 to 1e-12).  The corruption onset is STRICTLY above it (first confirmed corruption at 1e8G, a = 6.91e8); every sub-wall census row has a <= 4.886e8, so NO sub-wall row is in the corrupted region and their recorded logzeta channels stand.  The s34k probe (a = 5.9e8, C at dps-15/dps-40) pins the exact onset.  Confirmatory C crosses at the exact 5e7G and 2e7G row heights are queued.  (The earlier 'risk to the top sub-wall rows' wording was over-cautious: 4.886e8 is a confirmed clean point, not an unproven boundary.)  PROVENANCE POLICY (locked): zeta channel of record above the mpmath wall = the C/quad channel (bare-cos cross on each row); mpmath dps-20+ zeta at far heights (a >~ 5e8) is a KNOWN-CORRUPTED channel (rssum) and is not used for any datum; mpmath dps-15 and the C channel agree to 1e-12 where both can run (5e8G) and serve as the mutual validation band.  NOVELTY SCOPE: diagnostic + correction of an existing numerical pipeline (an mpmath working-precision pathology at its chain's high J/L/M regime - worth an upstream issue report to the mpmath maintainers); the C channel is standard RS formula + standard QD arithmetic; no RH claim.  MILESTONE HYGIENE: PATHWAY updated (the wall + C channel + corrected anchors block); s34g_far_correction.py records the corrected rows + shape (tmp/s34g_far_corrected.jsonl); the three locked M values and the far-drift shape are UNCHANGED (explicitly recorded as such, not silently).  NEXT: s34f 1e9G row lock (stream ~12 min), sub-wall C crosses, s34b chain 5, s34j 1e10G/3e20-9e20 rows, then the row set joins the s33 deconvolution (which will then consume 1e9G and beyond for the first time - the degeneracy-break question).  No RH claim.
